```{r} 
library(tidyverse)
library(hms)
library(rstatix)
library(flextable)
library(pins)

pal <-  c("#F0E442","#009E73","#56B4E9", "#E69F00","#0072B2") %>%  set_names(c("Standing", "Sitting", "Prone", "Supine", "Held"))
restraint_pal <-  c("#CC79A7","chartreuse4") %>%  set_names(c("Restrained", "Unrestrained"))

theme_update(text = element_text(size = 12),
             axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"), 
             axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
             axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12,  color = "black"), 
             axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14), 
             panel.background = element_blank(),panel.border = element_blank(), 
             panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
             panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), axis.line = element_blank(), 
             axis.ticks.length=unit(.25, "cm"), 
             legend.key = element_rect(fill = "white")) 

board <- board_folder("/Volumes/padlab/study_sensorsinperson/data_processed/datasets/")
data_version <- board %>% pin_meta("imu_raw_samples")
ds <- board %>% pin_read("imu_raw_samples") %>%
  filter(nap_period == 0, exclude_period == 0)

redcap <- board %>% pin_read("redcap_data") %>% 
  select(id, session, sitting, crawl, cruise, walk, aims_totalscore, percentile_rank,
         aims_prone_complete, aims_prone_total, aims_supine_complete, aims_supine_total,
         aims_sitting_complete, aims_sitting_total, aims_standing_complete, aims_standing_total) %>% 
  mutate(id = as.character(id), 
         aims_prone_total = ifelse(aims_prone_complete == "Yes", aims_prone_total, NA),
         aims_supine_total = ifelse(aims_supine_complete == "Yes", aims_supine_total, NA),
         aims_sitting_total = ifelse(aims_sitting_complete == "Yes", aims_sitting_total, NA),
         aims_standing_total = ifelse(aims_standing_complete == "Yes", aims_standing_total, NA),
         aims_totalscore = ifelse(aims_prone_complete == "Yes" & aims_supine_complete == "Yes" & aims_sitting_complete == "Yes" & aims_standing_complete == "Yes", aims_totalscore, NA),
         percentile_rank = ifelse(aims_prone_complete == "Yes" & aims_supine_complete == "Yes" & aims_sitting_complete == "Yes" & aims_standing_complete == "Yes", percentile_rank, NA))
```

| Last updated: `r round(now())` using pinned data version from: `r round(data_version$created)`
